subject.title: Control UI: Memory panel for MEMORY.md and USER.md

question: Should editable MEMORY.md, USER.md, and daily memory-note access ship as a dedicated core Control UI memory panel, as part of the generic workspace-file manager, or through a plugin-owned Control UI contribution surface?
rationale: Current main only partially satisfies the request, and the missing daily-note/editor surface crosses product ownership, security, and session-state boundaries that automation should not choose.

options.title: Keep boundary review open
options.body: Leave this issue open until maintainers choose the owner boundary and access model before implementation.

options.title: Build core memory panel
options.body: Implement a first-party Memory panel if maintainers want memory visibility/editing to be core UX rather than a generic file manager or plugin surface.

options.title: Fold into workspace or plugin UI slots
options.body: Use the workspace manager or Control UI contribution-slot RFC as the canonical path, then close this after it safely covers the memory use case.

recommendation.title: Keep boundary review open
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open until maintainers choose the owner boundary and access model before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent current-main history on the agents.files boundary and adjacent Control UI files surface.
